comment: Ground-truth technology tree. NEVER shown to agents except in the 'oracle' condition. All conditions are AND-ed.

recipes.feedback_success: You created an AXE! It feels sturdy.
You wove a BASKET. You can carry more now.
Sparks catch the dry grass — you created a FIRE!
recipes.comment: Same ingredients as pickaxe except quantity context; tile condition makes it non-obvious. Conflict note: fire = 1w+2s on grass, pickaxe = 1w+2s elsewhere. Resolution order: condition-specific recipes match FIRST.

recipes.feedback_success: You tilled the land and planted seeds — a FARM!
You roasted the berries. They smell wonderful.
You built a STOREHOUSE. Anyone can use it.

failure_feedback.comment: Experimental knob. low = 'Nothing happened. The materials were wasted.' medium = adds a directional hint ('the stones sparked but nothing caught'). high = names the missing condition. v0 default: low.

messages.low: Nothing happened. The materials crumbled uselessly.
messages.medium_near_miss: Something almost happened — {hint} — but it fell apart.
